text: This is the room: Dana, Marcus, and Greg, hearing what got built since a 48-hour outage funded this engagement -- and an honest account of one real gap a drill found along the way.
BrennanWSFC and BrennanAG now protect BrennanERP with a proven automatic failover. Backups are automated, verified, and copied off-site. brennan-mongo-01 is under the same real discipline.

Said plainly: ProductionSchedulingDB's AG-join step was scheduled for later and never finished. The scheduling module broke -- not because data was lost, but because it was never actually a member of BrennanAG.
The good news, meant honestly: found on a Tuesday, during a planned test, with nothing real at stake -- exactly what a real drill is supposed to do, instead of finding it during an actual failure.
Fixed, verified, and now backed by a recurring check. Next: writing this down so it never depends on one person's memory.
